question: Using Table 2A-2, identify the characteristic background colors for temporary traffic control, incident management, and ETC-account-only signs.
model_answer: Direct Answer: Per Table 2A-2, temporary traffic control signs characteristically use an orange background with a black legend. Incident management signs use an orange background and may also use a fluorescent pink background (with black legend). ETC-Account-Only signs use a purple background with a black legend, with the use of purple restricted per the provisions of Chapter 2F. Standards (mandatory): - For ETC Account-Only lanes/facilities, "the guide signs for such lanes or highways shall incorporate the pictograph... adopted by the toll facility's ETC payment system and the regulatory message ONLY. Except for ETC pictographs whose predominant background color is purple, if incorporated within the green background of a guide sign, the ETC pictograph shall be on a white rectangular or square panel set on a purple underlay panel with a white border. For rectangular ETC pictographs whose predominant background color is purple, a white border shall be used at the outer edges of the purple rectangle to provide contrast between the pictograph and the sign background color." Options (permitted): - "Warning signs used for TTC incident management situations may have a black legend and border on a fluorescent pink background." - "Guide signs used in TTC incident management situations may have a black legend and border on a fluorescent pink background." - "Detour signs in TTC incident management situations may have a black legend and border on a fluorescent pink background." - "Warning and guide signs used for TTC traffic incident management situations may have a black legend and border on a fluorescent pink background (see Figure 6O-1)." Support: - "Common uses of sign colors are shown in Table 2A-2. Color schemes on specific signs are shown in the illustrations located in each applicable Chapter." Visual evidence: [Image 4] shows Table 2A-2, in which "Temporary Traffic Control" is marked with a black legend and orange background, "Incident Management" is marked with a black legend and both orange and fluorescent pink backgrounds, and "ETC-Account Only" is marked with a black legend and a purple background (footnote 5 notes purple use is restricted per Chapter 2F). [Image 2] (Figure 6O-1) shows incident management signs (e.g., BE PREPARED TO STOP, EXIT CLOSED, DETOUR) with black legends on fluorescent pink backgrounds. [Image 3] (Figure 2F-8) shows ETC Account-Only guide signs featuring the ETC pictograph on purple panels with white borders. [Image 5] (Page 443, Figure 2F-16) confirms the purple background of ETC Account-Only toll plaza canopy signs. [Image 7] (Page 924, Figure 6P-12) illustrates typical temporary traffic control signs (W20-1, W20-4, W3-3) with orange backgrounds. Citations: - Table 2A-2 (p.43) - Section 2A.06 Support §3 (p.43) - Section 2F.03 Standard §2 (p.381) - Section 6H.01 Option §7 (p.798) - Section 6I.01 Option §4 (p.811) - Section 6I.02 Option §2 (p.811) - Section 6O.01 Option §10 (p.854) - Figure 6O-1 (p.855) - Figure 2F-8 (p.391) - Page 443 - Page 924
gold_answer: Temporary traffic control: orange; incident management: fluorescent pink; ETC-account-only: purple.
